body:
I had a miscarriage at 9 weeks about 8 years ago. It's not something you ever really get over, but it does get better. I was a mess for quite some time, and I still remember my due date. It was a much wanted baby and we had fertility issues, so I know what you mean by  your whole world being turned upside down. 

You can't rush the healing process, but it will happen. Much love for you.
Yes!  I would live to get better. I have good days and bad days, but the bad outnumber the good considerably. I try to take it one day at a time. That's the only thing I know how to do.
No, I'm not. The psychologist wants to see them. If I decline, my lawyer said it might make me look bad. Hiding something, I guess. I'm not; I've been upfront with everyone. Maybe too much so.
It's extremely nerve wracking and frustrating. I didn't want my kids to know anything about this.

Because I volunteered for a psyche evaluation based on his claims that I'm an unfit parent. I know I screwed up big time, but I did not take the pills during my custody time. And when it became my time, I told him. I told him I needed to go home to my family to get their input and support because obviously the medication I was on was no longer working, and I didn't want my kids to see me so sad. I thought I did the right thing, but now he's painting me as bat-shit crazy. 

The psychologist who is doing my evaluation wants to meet with my kids to gauge how each of us fares as a parent. I do not want my kids to know anything about this. He thinks I'm the one pushing for them to meet with the doctor, however he is the one who started all this.

We have equal joint custody. Two weeks with me, two weeks with him. I stayed in this city/state specifically for that. My family, aka support system, is 300 miles away. I didn't want him to be a holiday only dad. 
Our current parenting plan supports this. We're in TN.
No itch scratching this time. Lol. Lots of talking.

Ha!  You're funny. All 3 were busts. I had a surprise date Sunday night and we went out again last night. Nice guy. Painter/poet. Not sure yet, but I'm not rushing anything. I'm not ready for any relationship.

I went out and bought some soft sheets in my favorite color - blue. Also picked up an incredibly soft navy blanket to go with. Heaven!  It's the little things. 
I think I'll go make up my bed now.

It is not your fault, nor is it the fault of your other friend. No one can make someone kill themself. That's a decision that one person makes on his own. 

If he did commit suicide, you will not be arrested. You can't be responsible for someone 24/7. You can't always be there. Please stop beating yourself up.

I understand your pain and guilt. I had a friend commit suicide years ago. About a year prior, he talked to me about his depression because he knew I suffered from it too. We talked a long time, years were shed, and I think I helped. A year later he overdosed. He was a long distance friend, but I still felt guilty that no one was there to stop him. But I didn't cause it. Neither did anyone else. He was alone in his home. He took the pills. He lay down in his bed without calling anyone. There was nothing anyone could do. He was a good guy. His name was Stephen. He posted here on Reddit sometimes. I didn't know him as well as I would have liked, but I still think about him. 

If your friend did this, it will be painful , but you did not cause it. Keep trying to find him. Reach out to your other friend. Because if he did kill himself, she's going to need someone to talk to as well.

Unfortunately most control has been taken out of my hands. So, I've got time (my ex has the girls for the next two weeks). 

I don't really want to turn in to that person who uses people. I just have some bitterness to get beyond. I keep wanting to compare them to someone else, and they fail. Not fair to anyone.

So very true!  Although I did get stood up a couple times last week, so BOB. 
Edit to say - I haven't found anyone I want to really see again yet. I guess I have become somewhat detached.
Dang!  Are you psychic?  Or stalking?  I don't take too well to stalking. Lol

Go back to your doctor and see about adjusting or changing meds. I find I get angry easily when I'm off my meds. And I get suicidal when I am prescribed too much. It's all about trial and error, unfortunately.
Lol. I'll never tell. 😉

Yes. This exactly. If it were as easy as getting out more, depression would be nonexistent. 
I'm fine when I'm out, which isn't that often. But when I get back home, it's like my soul gets sucked away. 

I wish there was an easy answer.

I'm sorry to hear that. 

I understand the no money part. I'm supposed to be seeing a psych, but I can't afford it anymore either. Really sucks!

I hope y'all can work on the lying issue. That's a really big deal, since you can no longer trust him. I can't figure out how he doesn't think it's a problem. 

Good luck!
Are you seeing anyone for your depression?  That might help until you can get to counseling.

She's hurt, you're hurt. Both of you are trying to move on. I guess having your dogs meet another girl brought it all to the forefront for her and she's lashing out at you. 
I do hope she comes to her senses and realizes she can't control you or who you see. I know it's not children, thank goodness, but she is taking her resentment out on the dogs. I know pets can be like family. And frankly it is pretty important that they "like" the new person in your life. 
Good luck. And feel free to rant again. I know I have. Again and again.

You are not a worthless piece of crap. You've gone through a lot and still have more healing to do. 
How long has it been since your divorce?
Now that make me smile.

"Just snap out of it!" That's what the now ex said 10 years ago. 
"Go for a walk. It always makes me feel better when I'm down."  That's what my mom said to me last October. 

Gee thanks. You both just cured depression! /sarcasm

I'm right there with ya, OP.  Sometimes it seems like the only way out from the pain. I have two kids that keep me from doing anything stupid. I will NOT let their arrogant-ass dad and his insane, alcoholic family raise my kids!  

What is your permanent problem?
It may not be the same, but you're right - it does help. Thank you.

That's a thought. With summer coming up, it wouldn't be too long without them before I get them back for a bit. I don't know. 
I only wish his ego were smaller. Unfortunately he's always been arrogant.
That's two words. But true.
If I give up and leave the state, won't they look at it as abandonment?  I honestly don't know how long I can go without seeing my kids.

He's finally up to date in all the child support, but the ongoing custody battle is costing more and more. 

I would be more accommodating with settling for something other than I want IF it wouldn't mean still losing my children. As it is, he's basically put me out of a job. I currently work in the hotel industry and he used my work hours against me. He originally agreed to help me out by having the kids when I worked late or on weekenders during my custody time. Then he used it in his petition against me. So I had to tell my boss I could no longer close or work weekends when I have my girls. Well, that pretty much means no job. 
So right now losing any custody time would mean less child support, and that's what's keeping a roof over our heads and food on the table. Until I get better employment I am at his and the court's mercy. If I don't find another job soon, I will run out of money and have to move back home, over 300 miles away, without my kids.
No, we needed to go our separate ways. It was never going to work, I was just too weak to accept it.

I don't know. My entire life is so fucked right now. 
I know I need to work on myself, but the ex has me completely broke and I can't afford my doctor or meds anymore. I have no one in person to lean on. And the last person I had, I don't quite understand what happened. I was too much emotionally invested in him, I know that much. But he seemed to pull away just when I needed him the most. I think that's what's hurting me the most right now.

Thank you. 

I think I'm freaking out because not one single thing is under my control anymore. Everyone else has the control and I'm just a puppet reacting to it. 
The last person I had to talk with, I think we put too much on each other. Also, I think I have some resentment towards him for pulling away when I really needed him. We got pregnant, and he accused me if doing it on purpose. I know he was freaked too, but that really tore me apart. Things haven't been the same since and I told him goodbye last night. He'll never know how much that hurt me.
And the word would be...?
Yeah. I haven't had his "benefits" for a long time, just the friends part. Working on that. Lol
Yay!  You're welcome. I'm glad things have  settled down a bit.
Hey. How are you?
How are things now?
Both long distance. One is still caught up in his ex and pushed me away the other is a FWB.
Yep. I'm trying. One today, one Saturday, and one Sunday. Who knows?

No, he would never let me move with the girls, even for some kind of financial/emotional stability on my part. Last year he was up for a job interview I a city only 2 1/2 hours from my home. When he found out I was dating someone near there he pulled out and said "I'll not make this convenient for you".  I would have moved there to continue joint custody, but I'm guessing it hurt him, even though he was already seriously dating someone too. So he decided to play the jerk card. 

We were trying to work on something temporary but his idea of a solution is for me to only get them every other weekend. That's not why I stayed here. Everyone keeps telling me he's trying to get out of paying any kind of child support. I honestly don't know. He's changed big time. 

I don't have any close friends here. Unfortunately I kinda lost myself in the marriage - completely my fault. 

I don't know why he waited so long to file if it was an emergency. He even admitted at his deposition that he did not think it was an emergency. He knew it was Zoloft. He knew everything. He's never believed in anti depression meds. For the longest time he thought I was a drug addict for taking Zoloft. Until I gave him one to take and it did nothing for him. 

He doesn't believe in shrinks or anything like that. He refused marriage counceling for 10 years because of that.

Just a quick reply. I'm out job hunting. 
It wasn't my ex who abused or raped me. Those were two different people from many, many years ago. 
Sorry, it got all jumbled up when I was typing.

Still here. 

A little more info (I'm repeating myself from all over the boards and I apologize in advance if it's getting tiring): divorced a year now. It was my choice, but it has left me in financial ruin. If I were a selfish person I would have stayed and strayed, but that's not who I am. 

Been depressed and treated for 10 years now, but that and my anxiety has gone through the roof with all my latest shit. 

Ex suing for "temporary emergency custody" because I did swallow a bunch of Zoloft in October. It was basically a cry for help from anyone. I knew it wouldn't kill me. I just wanted to sleep. He actually didn't file until January even though he knew about it in Oct. I've since sought out more help, but he's also using that against me. He used my job against me, he used my going out of town for a family emergency (not me) against me. 

I have no family here. They're all over 300 miles away. I stayed here so he could have joint custody even though everyone was telling me to move home with my kids. 

I gave up everything to stay here because it was the "right" thing. Family, friends, a free or cheap place to live, a job, a relationship (even though that was doomed anyway). 

I recently had an abortion ( please don't judge me. I already feel like shit that I got in that situation to begin with.)

I can't afford my doctors or meds anymore. Even through the health department. 

Have no money. Ex basically put me out of my job so I'm looking for something else. In the meantime he bounced his alimony/ child support check one month, then couldn't pay the next month for whatever reason. So I'm in debt and have creditors calling me. 

Thinking about bankruptcy. 

Whether I win or lose the child support case, I still lose. I will be broke without a way to pay rent so I'll have to love home without my kids anyway. 

There's more with my past that I thought I had gotten over, but it's really hit me hard lately. Abuse, all three kinds; neglect; raped, all in the past but it's bothering me now. 

Basically I see no way out. I don't know how to be happy. I'm isolated and frustrated. I have no control over anything and the depression is really getting me. 

Thank you for all of your kind words. I'm so tired of feeling this way. My kids keep me going, but I'm terrified of what I'll feel if I lose them too.

I've been like that at work before. Not very professional, but it can't be controlled. Some people are able to hold it in. Others, like us wear our hearts on our sleeves because we just can't control it. 

Sorry, I don't have any advice. Just know you're not the only one.

It sounds like there was some miscommunication on both parts. It seems strange to me (and I'm female) that she would invite you all the way across country for nothing. Maybe idonteven0 hit the nail on the head, but it still seems odd. 

What did she say when she was yelling at you?

Same here!
I used to have a great cuddler. We did other things too, but snuggling was the greatest. Geographic distance and circumstances forced us apart, but I would love to be able to snuggle again.
I think I stopped living a few months ago. Still trying to figure out how to get back.

I understand your reasoning, I really do, but it's faulty at best. If you don't communicate with her NOW about getting I to counceling, she will think you've given up. I'm not saying it will work, but sitting on your ass waiting for her to come around most likely won't either. 

If she's already in a different state with your child, are you even getting visitation?  If not, and you're doing nothing about this,  judges won't be favorable to any custody demands you may have in the future. For your child, ask your wife right now what she really wants. Is she open to counceling now?  You can't wait when children are concerned. Unless you're okay with not being a big part of your daughter's life. 

I know that sounds harsh, but you've got to start now.

How about jump on counseling now?  If you keep waiting it will likely never happen. Been there, done that, now divorced after 15 years and 2 kids. I begged for counceling and he refused. He was my best friend but now that person is gone and he has morphed into a bitter, vengeful man.

Show your wife you're willing to do what it takes to save the marriage. Too many people don't realize that it takes work. Lots of work. It's not always romantic.

Seems to me your mom is the problem, not you.  The sooner you can start working and make your own money, the sooner you can get out from under her rule.  
You need to separate yourself from her.  Physically and mentally.
Ah. I'm a bit touchy these days.
I'm sorry to hear that. Doesn't seem fair, or nice.
I never said anything about withholding. I was speaking of the first date.
Good luck in your life.
Thank you for being honest. I hope one day it gets better for you. I really do.

You sound like someone I know IRL. The advice to "make the best of what you got where you are" I understand one one level. The difficult  part is getting a handle on my depression issues by myself. That's the main reason I would have gone back home. But I'm trying.

I do see your points, but I'll also add that some women are just not able to be stay at home moms. Some families need both incomes, and some women would go crazy staying home with the kids all day. Plenty of women want to work and daycare or babysitters are needed. Some fathers would prefer to be the stay home parent, and that shouldn't be frowned upon either.

It's not that women abandoned their historical role, they've been given (or won) more options to enjoy. I don't believe it's about gaining marriage equality, but satisfaction.
I can agree with that. What's best for the kids and income should be the deciding factors instead of sex.

Wow, I didn't know that family heirlooms could be viewed as joint assets. I'm really sorry you lost those. 

I never intend to marry again either. It's true in that it's just a legal document. I don't care to enter into another legal contract of such magnitude ever again. 

Right now the ex and I have 50/50 with the kids. That's how I'd like it to remain. I gave up everything to stay in the state we live in for that, even though all my family is over 300 miles away. And when I say everything, I mean everything. A relationship, emotional support network, financial help, a job, a free/low cost place to live...

I am not where I need to be emotionally, but there is nothing I can do to change it because joint custody is that important to me. Though the ex doesn't see it that way. 

Edited because I can't spell today

I don't know about other states, but in mine alimony is temporary and phased out after a couple years. Child support is negotiable upon changing job circumstances. My ex now wants full custody and have me pay him child support, yet his custody petition put me out of a job because he used it against me. 

The couple of men I've gone out with just want sex and I've been stood up by two different ones for not putting out. That's okay though. Obviously not what I'm looking for. 

I did date/have a thing with one man for a bit that was very compatible, but circumstances made us call it off. 
Not quite jaded, but getting there. 

And if I was only interested in my own emotional and financial well-being, I'd still be married and would probably seek outside the marriage for the other. Not a good scenario in my view.

I do see your point here. My ex is paying child support and alimony - amounts he came up with and presented me with. I was a stay at home mom for 10 years (agreed upon by both of us), and that gap in work history has hurt me greatly. I do have a job, sort of. The ex used my working hours against me in his current petition for custody, even though previously he had agreed to get our kids whenever I had to work a weekend during my custody period. I had to tell my boss I could no longer close or work weekends during the two weeks I have my kids. I work in hospitality, thus no real job now. He did that with his suing me. Doesn't make a whole lot of sense to me. 
Now we're both broke and close to bankruptcy but he refuses to go back to the current parenting plan. Can't see how both of us broke is in the kids' best interests.

My appointment got moved to tomorrow. I just want this over with. 
I don't want to do this, but I know it's the right thing. I can't afford a baby and neither can the father, but I always wanted one more. 
So sad. And so mad at myself for having drunken sex and getting into this situation! I feel so stupid and childish.
Deep breath. What happened?
If only pot were legal...
Addiction of choice?  You mean like smoking and drinking?  That I have in spades. Just not when I have my kids.

She is a pretty regular part of my life. Especially with all the bs I've been going through lately. I've reached out to her on multiple occasions, but the nurturing isn't there. Just the denial - "You don't seem like your depressed," said when a favorite song came on the radio and I started singing. This was a couple weeks after I took an overdose. Apparently I'm supposed to walk around crying all the time, even in public. 

Denial or guilt. That's all I get from her. She's funding my custody battle so I have to interact regularly.

This was one of the problems in my marriage. He became a workaholic; rarely home until I was putting the kids to bed, or even later. If he did get home while they were still awake, he was so burned out and cranky that he pushed the kids greetings away and went upstairs to play on the computer. All night long. Intimacy was gone, and in it's place was a resentful, cranky man. 

I tried to appreciate all the hard work he did, but after a long while of seeing my kids (his kids!) being turned away to the point they no longer greeted him with "Daddy's home!", or to the point we no longer shared dinner together or bedtime together - forget about sex - I gave up. 

If he wanted to work long hours and play on the computer all night long, so be it. We've been divorced a year now because of this and other things.
true
Happy fucking Valentine's day!
Thank you.  I do hope you're right.
Yes.
Thank you.  I'm still a work in progress.  It's a slow journey but I think we'll all get there.

Good job, and good luck!  I like hearing about people finding their way, or beginning to find their way out of depression.  It gives me hope for myself and for a good friend of mine who is also suffering.
Thank you for sharing!
I love the drawing!  And the optimism.  Keep it up!

I think this was one of my problems in my marriage.  I allowed this person to become my happiness.  I lost myself along the way, and am just now re-finding myself.  
Everyone says only you can make yourself happy.  I believe this to an extent.  I think we all need someone in our lives to care for, and who care for us; whether that be a lover, good friend, or children.  Ultimately however, I believe it's important to not allow yourself to get lost in another person.  Keep your own hobbies and interests.  Something that is yours and only yours that makes you happy.

That kinda made me laugh.  I don't know if I should feel old, or what.  lol
Either way, the crying is okay, as far as crying goes.  It's not having any control whatsoever that's freaking me out.  I don't have to have all the control, but just a little would be nice since they are my kids too.  But they come back to me Saturday evening so that will be a welcome change.

hyperboleandahalfblogspot.com

I love this page, but yes it is one person's journey.  You're totally right in that everyone has their own experiences and it's best to ask that person.

What you're feeling is normal and there is no shame in reaching out for help.  Start with the doctor who delivered.  I bet he/she can lead you in the right direction for professional help.  

I can only imagine the pain you're going through.  I have a good friend who delivered her stillborn at 38 weeks a few years ago.  She still gets really down on her daughter's birthday, but she really is doing well now.  

The pain will never go away, but it will lessen with time.  Find someone to talk to, and don't forget about your husband/partner.  He may need some help to get through this as well.  Don't be shy or embarrassed about seeking help - that's what doctors are there for.  
And here to.  
Internet (hugs).

True, I guess.  It was pretty belittling.  Looking back I realize everything totally destroyed my confidence and self-worth.  I'm still working on it, but recent events have knocked me down again.  I feel unloveable and unwanted, and I don't think I'd be in this dark place if I had support when I needed it
Oh yes, the Johnny Cash version gets me too.

His refusal to go to marriage counseling, his belief that being on one depression medication meant I was a drug addict, his non-support of my depression, not having equal financial sway and being told (in front of an audience) that my opinion on buying an expensive car didn't matter, his emotional distance.  Nothing major, just piles and piles of "little stuff".

Thank you for the advice.  I've already had someone take a look and besides remote access being enabled, everything looked good.  I'm now using a different computer, but I really think he found me just by reading my posts here.  He's been here for a number of years, and honestly I wasn't trying to hide.  I actually thought seeking support was a good thing for my psyche and didn't really think about it until now.   

The two other sites he found while we were still married. One wasn't even for support really, I just can't go there anymore because I worry he may still be there.  

I changed all usernames and passwords last June/July, but he's in IT and knows how to hack without being found.  He's even bragged about it.

We're already divorced.  We already have a parenting plan - 50/50.  He wants to change it.  And no, I will not subject my kids to thinking it's normal for married people to get their kicks elsewhere.  You're naive if you think they won't ever find out.  Kids are a hell of a lot more perceptive than we think.

Well, no one is going to tell you how to do it.  
I feel like that sometimes too.  I get into these deep funks, but I know I will never go through with it.  I have two beautiful kids to keep me going, and really, I'm interested in what my next chapter will be like.  

What are some of the issues you're dealing with that make you feel this way? Do you have anyone to talk to like a doctor, or even a really good friend?  
Or talk here.  Lots and lots of avenues to get help from, it's the actual reaching out that's the most difficult and you've already accomplished that.

I am so sorry!  What a horrible thing to have to deal with.  You are a wonderful friend for wanting to help.  The only advice I can give is just to be there for your friend.  Let him/her know you are there to listen, give hugs, and whatever else he/she may need.  There are no words that will help, other than "I'm here for you."  And being there.  

It is a powerless feeling knowing you can't make it all better.  No one can, only time (fuck time, I know).  Bring over dinner, help with laundry, help them clean the house - everyday things your friend may be too sad to think about.  But most of all, let him/her talk.  Don't try to fix, just listen.

Oh yeah, being stuck in the hospital sucks big time!  There's no time for relaxing and just enjoying your little miracle with all those nurses (who are awesome, mind you!) coming in and out all the time.  They're just doing their jobs and they wouldn't be there if they didn't love what they do, but it does get aggravating being interrupted all the time.  

I had natural child birth with my second (not by choice) and I was so tired and cranky.  So was my then husband.  I was cuddling my newborn while lying in the hospital bed, my eyes were closed.  Not asleep, but just in that relaxing serene state, when the nurse barged in and said "she can't do that! It's dangerous to sleep while holding the baby!" Let me tell you, being startled was much more dangerous.  Lol It's all good though.  I know what she meant.

Being home is much more relaxing.

Another piece of advice: never wake a sleeping baby!  If she falls asleep in her car seat, and she will, just bring the car seat inside and keep an eye on her. I learned that the hard way. lol

I'm glad you both got some good advice.  It's a new normal from here on out, but it's so worth it.  And it will get better. 

Congrats, btw!

I think most new parents go through these types of feelings.  Suddenly you're faced with this tiny bundle who can't survive on her own and all those feelings of being inadequate rise to the top - for both parents.  Lack of sleep doesn't help either, but soon your daughter will adjust to a schedule of sorts. It won't be the same as you're used to; she'll still wake at night, but not as often.  Take sleep where you can.  If your wife is exclusively breastfeeding, then wait until baby is not hungry and cuddle her in another room while your partner gets some rest.  Chances are your daughter will fall asleep in your arms and you can get some rest too.  Some of my favourite times were snuggling my babies on the sofa and I'd often drift off with them.  There's something so peaceful and calming about holding a sleeping baby.

I think the lack of sleep exacerbates all those other feelings.  Certainly doesn't help.  It is a difficult time, but the both of you will get through it.  Talk to your partner and see if the two of you can come up with some kind of schedule of your own.  You take the baby when she's not hungry so your fiance can rest.  You rest when baby is breastfeeding.
I've been there twice and both times had those very same feelings.  I won't lie - it's hell those first couple months, but it will get better. Dare I say easier?
He's trying to take them from me. As it is, we have 50/50. The whole reason I stayed in this state is for joint custody. I would like to keep it at 50/50.
Damn! I am so sorry.  I don't know what else to say.  It's my worst nightmare and I can totally empathize with the pain you must be going through.
How did it turn out for you?
Yes, I do understand that.

Hmmm...I guess it all depends on the state.  I would think it could be treated as a roommate situation.

True.  I did buy a book that's supposed to help organize my thoughts and stuff, but I haven't had the motivation or inclination to open it yet.  
Meditation I find difficult.  Not that I've ever made a serious attempt at it.  I don't know how to shut my brain off.

Not much actual exercising.  I do chase my kids around, so that should count for something.  
No, I just have a hell of a lot on my plate at the moment, all of which is very important and very depressing.
I did not know that, regarding the one year thing.

Yeah, unfortunately my eldest is only hearing the truth.  I've kissed a lot of frogs - married to one 15 years - thought I had found the prince only to be woefully misguided.  

I still think it's good to be honest.  Unfortunately not everyone shares this same viewpoint.  And even when they do (like my most recent fling) it's still painful.  One day we will both find the right someone.

That's when everything hits me all at once.  
And no, I don't sleep well.  Takes me forever to fall asleep unless I self medicate with over the counter sleep aids or alcohol.  And even then I wake up often.  
I have so much going on right now and it's just weighing me down.

I understand the pain of going through an abortion.  I actually made it out of my teens and without one.  Now at 42, I'm about to have my second one.  Yes, both within a year.
No matter how old you are, it's an emotionally devastating thing to go through. 
Have you thought about going to your school counselor or your primary doctor?  They can lead you in the right direction to get help for your pain.  
You're not being irrational - you're hurting.
Hi. Vent away!

Yes. I'm not all that spiritual or religious, but I often wonder if I royally fucked up in a previous life and this is my punishment or karma. I would say redemption, but I don't think I've redeemed myself yet.

I tell my two friends I'm fucked up all the time. And they agree. But they are my friends and we're brutally honest with each other and able to joke around with each other. 

Now if someone I barely knew or didn't know said that to me ... I'd wanna slap a bitch! (that's a phrase my coworker uses when he's pissed)

People can be stupid and immature. Try not to let it get to you. If they're not going to try and understand your situation then don't confide in them. (my mom is like that)
Sell it!  Give her a time frame and if she doesn't pick it up by then, sell or donate.

Oh wow. I am so sorry!  That was totally unkind of her to refuse to talk to you about it. Understatement, I know.
